text: 上证指数午盘涨0.27%，创业板指跌0.17%，科创综指跌1.38%，科创50跌2.09%，深证成指跌0.06%，万得全A跌0.01%，北证50涨1.8%，大市成交0.92万亿元。房地产盘初深跌后强势反弹，医药板块表现突出，银行、煤炭等红利资产非常活跃。存储股明显承压，光通信拉回拉锯，中际旭创、新易盛冲高回落。 全市场ETF行情总览（已剔除重复跟踪标的） 涨幅前五的ETF：疫苗ETF嘉实涨3.95%，科创创新药ETF国泰涨3.37%，疫苗ETF国泰涨3.09%，创新药ETF银华涨3.08%，生物医药ETF天弘涨3.04%。 跌幅前五的ETF：科创半导体E
text_en: The Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.27% at midday, the ChiNext Index fell 0.17%, the STAR Composite Index fell 1.38%, the STAR 50 fell 2.09%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.06%, Wind All A fell 0.01%, and the Beijing 50 rose 1.8%, with market turnover at 0.92 trillion yuan. Real estate rebounded strongly after an early sharp decline, the pharmaceutical sector performed prominently, and dividend assets such as banks and coal were very active. Memory stocks came under clear pressure, optical communications pulled back in choppy trading, and Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink surged then fell back. Overview of the overall market ETF performance (duplicate tracking targets excluded) Top five gainers: Jiashi Vaccine ETF up 3.95%, Guotai STAR Innovative Drug ETF up 3.37%, Guotai Vaccine ETF up 3.09%, Yinhua Innovative Drug ETF up 3.08%, and Tianhong Biomedical ETF up 3.04%.
